result.title: SWIFT: Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely Action for Asynchronous Autonomous Driving
result.summary: Driving scenes keep changing during model computation, making both observation freshness and action-delivery time central to world-action planning. To retain rich generative world priors in autonomous driving without stalling real-time control, we present SWIFT (Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely action), a deployment-oriented asynchronous world-action system that moves world updates off the observation-to-action critical path. On a background GPU, a slow Video DiT streams surround-view history into read-only predictive world context, trained with a predictive span that covers both the update interval and background world computation. On a foreground GPU, a lightweight freshness carrier encodes current surround-view images into a gated key/value bank at every step, letting a fast Action DiT combine live visual feedback with the latest completed world context without waiting. On open-loop NAVSIM, SWIFT reaches 94.2 PDMS at 198.4 ms per decision with a trajectory scorer; on closed-loop Bench2Drive, it achieves an 80.30 Driving Score at 109.9 ms foreground latency. SWIFT further transfers to the Waymo E2E hidden test (8.0050 Rater Feedback Score) and nuScenes (0.54 m mean endpoint error, 0.03% mean collision rate). Across all four benchmarks, SWIFT achieves the best results among compared world-action methods, establishing a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向自动驾驶的异步 world-action 系统：后台 GPU 用慢速 Video DiT 持续输出预测世界上下文，前台轻量「freshness carrier」每步把当前环视图像编码为带门控的 KV bank，供快速 Action DiT 在不等待的情况下融合实时视觉反馈与最新世界上下文。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「慢预测状态＋门控 KV 注入新鲜视觉证据」的机制，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态过期、何时引入新视觉证据及视觉旁路设计相关，可供核查；但任务是驾驶规划而非多模态推理，是否可迁移尚不明确。
